definitions: A person who protects innocence, especially that of children, from the corrupting influences of the adult world.
Someone who tries to preserve childhood and prevent others from 'falling off' into maturity or disillusionment.
examples: She saw herself as a catcher in the rye, always looking out for the younger kids.
His desire to be a catcher in the rye stemmed from his own difficult adolescence.
The character embodies the spirit of a catcher in the rye, wanting to save others from pain.
